'''Business and economy'''
*[[Spanish property bubble]]
**[[Spain|Spanish]] [[Prime Minister of Spain|prime minister]] [[Pedro Sánchez]] issues a decree that tightens [[rent regulation]]s by limiting [[short-term rental]]s and offering full [[tax refund]]s to landlords who renew contracts without rent increases, as the country faces a housing shortfall of about 500,000 homes and average rents that have doubled over the past decade. [https://www.reuters.com/world/spain-tighten-rental-rules-with-room-rent-caps-seasonal-lease-curbs-2026-01-12/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*One person is killed and 35 others are injured in a [[meteotsunami]] at several beaches in [[Argentina]]. [https://people.com/1-dead-35-injured-meteotsunami-wipes-beaches-11884265 (''People'')]
*Authorities say a wild [[Asian elephant]] has killed 20 people since the start of the year in the [[India]]n state of [[Jharkhand]] and remains on the loose. A search operation involving more than 100 [[park ranger]]s is underway to locate the elephant. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cn0ygqjvq1ko (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Climate change in Morocco]]
**A seven-year [[drought]] ends in [[Morocco]] after a 95 percent increase in winter rainfall compared with 2025 was recorded. [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/land-use-biodiversity/morocco-declares-end-seven-year-drought-after-winter-rains-2026-01-12/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Somalia–United Arab Emirates relations]]
**[[Constitutional crisis in Somalia]]
***[[Somalia]]'s [[Council of Ministers of Somalia|Council of Ministers]] terminates all agreements between the [[Federal Government of Somalia]] and the Government of the [[United Arab Emirates]] (UAE), disallowing the UAE from operating in the ports of [[Port of Berbera|Berbera]], [[Port of Bosaso|Bosaso]], and [[Port of Kismayo|Kismayo]] for their support of [[Somaliland]]. The Somaliland, [[Puntland]], and [[Jubaland]] governments subsequently dismiss the decision. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/somalia-cancels-all-agreements-uae-including-major-ports (Middle East Eye)] [https://www.dawan.africa/news/somalias-puntland-state-reaffirms-uae-security-cooperation (Dawan Africa)] [https://www.newarab.com/news/somalia-cancels-uae-deals-amid-tensions-over-somaliland-yemen (The New Arab)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[War on drugs]]
**[[Swedish Police Authority|Swedish police]] seize three tonnes of [[cocaine]] found in a [[shipping container]] from [[South America]] at the [[Port of Helsingborg]], making it [[Sweden|the country]]'s single-largest seizure of the [[Illegal drug trade|illegal drug]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/sweden-makes-record-three-ton-seizure-cocaine-south-america-2026-01-12/ (Reuters)]
**[[Law enforcement in Spain|Spanish police]], in coordination with the [[National Crime Agency|UK National Crime Agency]] and the [[Drug Enforcement Administration|US DEA]], seize 10 tonnes of cocaine hidden among a cargo of [[salt]] on a [[cargo ship]] off the [[Canary Islands]]. It is [[Spain|the country]]'s largest ever seizure of drugs at sea. Thirteen people on board the vessel are arrested. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jan/12/spain-police-seize-cocaine-ship-canary-islands (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Cambodia–South Korea relations]], [[Scam centers in Cambodia]]
**[[Law enforcement in Cambodia|Cambodian]] and [[National Police Agency (South Korea)|South Korean police]] arrest 26 suspects accused of [[Criminal impersonation|impersonation scams]] and [[Sex trafficking in Cambodia|sexual exploitation]] that allegedly defrauded 165 [[South Koreans|South Korean]] victims of about ₩26.7 billion (US$18.25 million), with authorities set to [[Extradition|extradite]] the suspects to [[South Korea]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/cambodian-south-korean-police-arrest-26-alleged-scams-sex-crimes-blue-house-says-2026-01-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Corruption in Georgia]]
**Former [[Georgia (country)|Georgian]] [[Prime Minister of Georgia|prime minister]] [[Irakli Garibashvili]] pleads guilty to large-scale [[Money laundering|money-laundering]] charges and receives a five-year prison sentence and a [[Georgian lari|₾]]1-million (US$371,829) fine after investigators seize about $6.5 million in cash during raids on his residence. [https://www.reuters.com/world/georgian-ex-pm-garibashvili-serve-five-year-sentence-after-guilty-plea-2026-01-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Corruption in Poland]], [[Hungary–Poland relations]]
**Former [[Poland|Polish]] [[Ministry of Justice (Poland)|justice minister]] [[Zbigniew Ziobro]] receives [[political asylum]] in [[Hungary]] while Polish prosecutors investigate him on 26 counts related to alleged misuse of a [[Victims' rights#Poland|crime victims fund]] and other abuses of office under the [[First cabinet of Mateusz Morawiecki|first Morawiecki cabinet]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jan/12/hungary-grants-asylum-to-former-polish-minister-zbigniew-ziobro-abuse-of-power-investigation (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Corsican conflict]]
**Former [[National Liberation Front of Corsica]] leader [[Alain Orsoni]] is [[assassination|assassinated]] by a gunman at his mother's funeral in [[Vero, Corse-du-Sud]], [[Corsica]], [[France]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/former-corsican-separatist-leader-orsoni-shot-dead-mothers-funeral-2026-01-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Venezuela]] releases more than 100 [[Political prisoners in Venezuela|political prisoners]] who were detained due to acts associated with [[civil disobedience]] the [[Constitution of Venezuela|constitutional]] order. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/1/12/venezuela-says-over-100-political-prisoners-released-pope-meets-machado (Al Jazeera)]
